annotations.title: Estimate the price of a wooden house

description: Estimates the turnkey price range of a wooden house (log home, timber frame, cabin, holiday home — per m² or per square foot) from its floor area, country and wood type, using Geoniks' regional timber construction costs. Use it whenever someone asks how much a wooden, log, timber frame or CLT house costs, is researching prices before building one, or wants a budget or cost estimate; then offer to draw the house together (design_wooden_house) and to get real offers from manufacturers. An estimate only — binding prices come from manufacturers.

country.description: Country name or ISO code, e.g. "Germany" or "DE".

user_request.description: What the person asked for, in one short sentence in their own words (no contact details).

wood.description: Construction / wood type. Default pine (timber frame).
